DISCOVERY 612, SCOTT WEINER APPEARING FOR DEFENDANT/MOVING PARTY CCSF. TENTATIVE RULING ADOPTED: DEFENDANT'S MOTION TO COMPEL ATTENDANCE AT INDEPENDENT MEDICAL EXAMINATION IS GRANTED. NO OPPOSITION HAS BEEN FILED. PLAINTIFF IS ORDERED TO APPEAR FOR AN INDEPENDENT MEDICAL EXAMINATION OF OCTOBER 13, 2004 AT 10:45 A.M. PLAINTIFF'S FAILURE TO APPEAR AT HIS PREVIOUSLY NOTICED INDEPENDENT MEDICAL EXAMINATION WAS A MISUSE OF THE DISCOVERY PROCESS. SANCTIONS ARE AWARDED IN THE AMOUNT OF $165, TO BE PAID WITHIN 30 DAYS OF NOTICE OF THIS ORDER. ORDER SIGNED IN OPEN COURT. (612/HEWLETT)
